IT is hereby published for the public to know that it has been decided under secretary decision no. 01 on. 03.10.2024 of no. 01 of the decision committee held on 03.10.2024 that the roads and lanes included in the schedule below should be declared as the roads and lanes owned by the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha as the duty vested to the pradeshiya sabha of Sabaragamuwa province “the series of orders regarding the preparation of plans and publication of notices showing the list of roads and lanes maintain by the pradeshiya sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province” as publication by governor of Sabaragamuwa Province in the extraordinary gazette no. 2316/20 dated 24th January 2023 to be read with section 24 of pradeshiya sabha act no. 15 of 1987.

It is hereby announced that in order to prove their right to the said land, they should act before the expiry of a period of three month from the date of this announcement to file a case in the competent court, if it is the opinion of the party entitled to the land that any road or lane included in the said schedule passes through any land or part of any land.

It is further announced that every road and lane included in the said schedule for which no such case has been assigned before the said period of three months shall be deemed to have been vested roads and lanes in the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
T.R.C.K. Gunasekara, Secretary and the implementation Officer Carrying out the functions Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
